items.excerpt_en: Chronohaze brings together Feier Lyu’s current work in optimization, formal verification, music production, and photography.
items.content: Origin / Chronohaze Feier Lyu Fay OPTIMIZATION · FORMAL VERIFICATION · MACHINE-CHECKED MATHEMATICS In the haze of time, I look for structure in complexity. I work on optimization and formal verification. As HazezZ, I write and produce music and make photographs. University of Edinburgh, BSc Mathematics · Cornell University Exchange · Expected Graduation 2027 Two Archive of Formal Proofs entries · one independent formalization · one developed under the supervision of Wenda Li Contact me CURRENT WORK Research Snapshot PUBLISHED · AFP · 2026 · SOLE AUTHOR First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Reusable Isabelle/HOL infrastructure for smooth convex first-order optimization, including projection geometry, projected-gradient mappings, convergence certificates, and linear rates. AFP entry Proof document Project note GitHub PUBLISHED · AFP · 2026 · FORMALIZATION · SUPERVISED BY WENDA LI Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization Classical greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant for cardinality-constrained monotone submodular maximization. AFP entry ONGOING · JOINT RESEARCH Second-Order Geometry in Network Localization A collaborative study of network structure and second-order geometry. Research record TWO PRACTICES Two identities, two practices Reason and romance sit side by side here: proof, sound, and image each keep their own language. ACADEMIC IDENTITY · FEIER LYU Mathematics Theorems, Isabelle/HOL, and optimization notes, from machine-checked proofs to structured nonconvex problems. AFP theorem PGD AFP entry Technical notes CREATIVE IDENTITY · HAZEZZ Music & Image Performance, composition, and photographic series, each given its own complete narrative space. Music / Performance Photography / Moving Image Now / September 2026 Last updated 2026. 09 StochasticGreedy / Isabelle/HOL The approximation and oracle-cost theorem line is in place; current work focuses on the probabilistic-semantics layer needed to connect reusable proofs with executable sampling. 起死開戦 / Bass Recently practicing millsage’s “起死開戦.” The bass part is brutally difficult, but I know I can get it down. Music production I’ve just completed an original commissioned song for a group, and I’m continuing to write my own music alongside several collaborative projects.

items.title: Selected Work
items.excerpt: 精选形式化项目、优化研究笔记、合作研究方向，以及作为侧项目展示的创意计算原型。
items.excerpt_en: Selected formalizations, optimization research notes, collaborative research directions, and a supporting creative-computation prototype.
items.content: 代表性工作 研究陈述 技术笔记 代表性工作 Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） 已发表成果与当前项目。 Selected Work Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) Published work and current projects. 代表性工作 代表性工作 01 已发表 · AFP · 2026 · 独立作者 First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL 状态： 2026 年 7 月 2 日正式发表于 Archive of Formal Proofs。 问题： 将光滑凸一阶优化组织成可复用的 Isabelle/HOL 基础设施，并以投影梯度下降作为核心应用。 贡献： 完成完整 Isabelle/HOL 形式化开发，涵盖投影几何、下降与望远镜求和结构、投影梯度映射、残差证书、凸收敛率以及强凸条件下的线性收敛。 链接： AFP 证明文档 项目回顾 GitHub 02 已发表 · AFP · 形式化开发 · Wenda Li 指导 Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization 状态： 2026 年 5 月 26 日正式发表于 AFP。AFP 条目覆盖经典贪心算法与经验证的有状态惰性贪心变体；当前仓库另含发表后的 StochasticGreedy 扩展，包括采样模型、近似证明与预言机调用复杂度界。 问题： 形式化基数约束单调子模最大化中经典贪心算法的 1−1/e 近似保证。 贡献： 在 Wenda Li 老师指导下，本人负责完整的 Isabelle/HOL 形式化开发。 链接： AFP 证明文档 GitHub DOI 03 合作研究 · 网络定位 Second-Order Geometry in Network Localization 状态： 与 Shoham Sabach、Owen Li 开展中的合作研究。 问题： 对网络定位中的非最优 stationary points，哪些图结构与几何条件控制其二阶行为？ 公开范围： 当前只公开问题背景、研究目标与已经确认的高层结论；完整技术材料可按需提供。 链接： 研究概览 探索性归档 Exploratory Archive NOTE 探索性笔记 · 极小极大优化 TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking 状态： 探索性推导；保留供定向阅读，不列入代表性工作主序列。 问题： 双时间尺度值函数跟踪能否通过 Schur 补 Hessian 支持二阶鞍点逃逸？ PDF 技术笔记 创意计算 实验性原型 SIDE 创意计算 / 实验性原型 Metalcore Piano Lab 状态： 侧项目 · 实验性原型 · 开发中；不作为研究成果列出。 问题： 如何把连续的音频与节奏流转换为保留节拍、段落与可玩性约束的离散谱面？ 贡献： 设计并实现浏览器原生的分析与谱面生成原型，包括起音检测、节拍网格、段落对齐与可玩性约束。 链接： GitHub 项目笔记 SELECTED WORK Selected Work 01 PUBLISHED · AFP · 2026 · SOLE AUTHOR First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Status: Published in the Archive of Formal Proofs on July 2, 2026. Problem: Develop reusable Isabelle/HOL infrastructure for smooth convex first-order optimization, with projected-gradient descent as the central application. Contribution: Developed the full Isabelle/HOL entry, including projection geometry, descent and telescoping infrastructure, projected-gradient mappings, residual certificates, convex convergence rates, and linear convergence under strong convexity. Links: AFP Proof document Project note GitHub 02 PUBLISHED · AFP · FORMALIZATION · SUPERVISED BY WENDA LI Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization Status: Published in the Archive of Formal Proofs on May 26, 2026. The AFP entry covers classical greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant; the current repository additionally contains a post-publication stochastic-greedy extension with the sampling model, approximation proof, and oracle-cost bounds. Problem: Formalize the classical 1−1/e approximation guarantee for cardinality-constrained monotone submodular maximization. Contribution: I was responsible for the full Isabelle/HOL development under the supervision of Wenda Li. Links: AFP Proof document GitHub DOI 03 ONGOING COLLABORATION · NETWORK LOCALIZATION Second-Order Geometry in Network Localization Status: Ongoing collaboration with Shoham Sabach and Owen Li. Problem: Which graph and geometric conditions control second-order behavior near non-optimal stationary points in network localization? Public scope: This page states only the background, research objective, and confirmed high-level conclusions. Full technical material is available on request. Links: Research overview EXPLORATORY ARCHIVE Exploratory Archive NOTE EXPLORATORY NOTE · MINIMAX OPTIMIZATION TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking Status: Exploratory derivation retained for directed reading; not part of the primary Selected Work sequence. Problem: Can two-timescale value-function tracking support second-order saddle escaping through the Schur-complement Hessian? PDF note CREATIVE COMPUTATION Experimental Prototype SIDE CREATIVE COMPUTATION / EXPERIMENTAL PROTOTYPE Metalcore Piano Lab Status: Side project · experimental prototype · work in progress; not presented as a research output. Problem: How can continuous audio / rhythm streams become discrete charts while preserving beat, section, and playability constraints? Contribution: Designed and implemented the browser-native analysis and chart-generation prototype, including onset detection, beat grids, section alignment, and playability constraints.
